name: Data table
category_description: Core node - built-in logic, data or generic API functionality
description: Use the Data Table node to create and manage internal data tables. Data tables allow you to store structured data directly inside n8n and use it across workflows

operation_details.summary: Use this operation to delete one or more rows from a data table, based on a defined condition(s)

parameters.name: Resource:
parameters.description: Select Row

parameters.name: Operation:
parameters.description: Select Delete

parameters.name: Data table:
parameters.description: Select how to identify the data table to operate on:

parameters.name: Must Match:
parameters.description: Select whether to delete rows that match Any Condition or All Conditions defined in the next step

parameters.name: Conditions:
parameters.description: Click Add Condition to define which rows from the data table to operate on. You can add multiple conditions. For each one:

options.name: Dry Run:
options.description: Enable to simulate deletion without modifying the table. The node returns rows that would be deleted, including their state before and after the operation

parameters.name: Operation:
parameters.description: Select Get

parameters.name: Data table:
parameters.description: Select how to identify the data table to operate on:

parameters.name: Must Match:
parameters.description: Select whether to get rows that match Any Condition or All Conditions defined in the next step

parameters.name: Conditions:
parameters.description: Click Add Condition to define which rows from the data table to operate on. You can add multiple conditions. For each one:

parameters.name: Return All:
parameters.description: Enable to return all matching rows. Or, disable and enter a Limit for the number of rows to return, for example 50

parameters.name: Order By:
parameters.description: Enable to define the column to order results on, and the direction (ascending or descending). Or, disable for no ordering of results

options.name: To get a fully accurate result:
options.description: Make sure no one is adding, editing, or deleting records until the fetch is completely finished

options.name: If you're using "Return All":
options.description: If new matching records keep getting added while the fetch is running, Return All may never finish, since there's always more data to retrieve. If that happens, you can cancel the operation, and it will stop after the current batch finishes
